title: Business Central OAuth2 Credentials
description: Dynamics 365 Business Central OAuth2 authentication using Azure Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)

azureClientId.title: Azure Client ID
azureClientId.description: The Application (Client) ID from your Azure Entra ID app registration

azureClientSecret.title: Azure Client Secret
azureClientSecret.description: The client secret value from your Azure Entra ID app registration

azureTenantId.title: Azure Tenant ID
azureTenantId.description: Your Azure Entra ID tenant ID (Directory ID / Tenant GUID)

companyId.title: Business Central Company ID
companyId.description: The GUID of the company in Business Central (find in Setup > Company Information, or via API)

environmentName.title: Business Central Environment Name
environmentName.description: The environment name in Business Central (e.g., 'Production', 'Sandbox', or a custom environment name). This is case-sensitive and must match exactly.

apiVersion.title: API Version (Optional)
apiVersion.description: The Business Central API version (e.g., 'v2.0', 'v1.0'). Defaults to 'v2.0' if not specified.
